waypoints.name: Punta Arenas, Chile
waypoints.event: Expedition start. Arrived by air via Falklands on night of 31 Oct; assembled trailer ('the beast') and moved ~20 yards before wheel/axle failure (night 31 Oct/1 Nov, 'Day one'). Site and press releases give 1 Nov 1998 as start date; real walking began Mon 2 Nov 1998 at 10:36 after repairs (see conflicts).

waypoints.name: Night stop 2 Nov 1998 (journal grid; longitude suspect)
waypoints.event: Day 1 walking, 10 miles; camp on cliff overlooking Strait of Magellan. Reported grid 52°59'S 71°50'W lies west of Punta Arenas - longitude probably a slip (70°50'?); not used for routing.
waypoints.coord_issue: 日誌座標經度可疑（研究時已標記），換算位置落在 Otway 灣海面上；第一天實際是沿主幹道北行。

waypoints.event: Detained by Panamanian police (no visa / no exit stamp). Held here to 20 Feb, then moved offroute (helicopter forced landing at Yaviza, truck to Meteti cells 20-23 Feb, boat to La Palma prison 23 Feb-5 Mar). 18 days custody. Returned to Boca de Cupe 7 Mar; restarted 8 Mar with officer's signature as proof.

waypoints.event: Custody 20-23 Feb; Karl: 'I was far better off in Meteti.'

waypoints.name: La Palma prison (custody, offroute)
waypoints.event: Custody 23 Feb-5 Mar; released to walk on and collect visa in Panama City.

waypoints.name: Meteti (walking), Panama

waypoints.event: Arrived 16 Mar ('6,671 miles from his starting point' - home team). Pause to 4 Apr (no money, depression; resupply at embassy).

waypoints.name: Egvekinot, Chukotka
waypoints.event: Spring 2007 walk ended here (walked 'down' from Amguema); left Russia ~21 May 2007 because permit was only 2 months. Spur end-point: the main line later continued north from Amguema.

waypoints.name: 'Valinistiy' (Valunisty?) mining camp, ~200 km from Amguema
waypoints.event: First waypoint of the summer/autumn 2007 leg; 4-5 rest days. Coordinates not verified.

waypoints.name: Komsomolsky, Chaunsky district, Chukotka
waypoints.event: Arrived after 474 km along mining-truck track; went to Pevek (off-route) for supplies; departed Pevek/Komsomolskiy 28 Oct 2007.

waypoints.name: Dvoynoye mining camp (Kinross), between Komsomolsky and Bilibino
waypoints.event: Furthest point of 2007 ('out of fuel and food'). Then helicopter/convoy out, flight from Anadyr 13 Dec 2007. Restart point of 2008. Coordinates deliberately null (not verified).

waypoints.name: Bilibino, Chukotka
waypoints.event: 2008 season end (thaw; 90-day visa). Expedition stalled here until 10 Mar 2011.

waypoints.name: Anyuysk, Chukotka
waypoints.event: Left Bilibino 10 Mar 2011; ~300 km / 10 days to Anyuysk; left 22 Mar towards Chersky. (Coordinates approximate.)

waypoints.name: Stadukhinskaya channel, Nizhnekolymsky district, Yakutia (border-guard protocol)
waypoints.event: Border post 'Cherskiy' soldiers wrote a protocol for lacking a permit for Nizhnekolymsky district. Almost certainly the incident later cited for the entry ban.

waypoints.name: Srednekolymsk, Yakutia
waypoints.event: End of 2011 season (~1,100 km from Bilibino). Exact resume point in March 2015.

waypoints.name: Los Angeles, California (start of off-route protest walk)
waypoints.event: Start of 'The 3000' walk to the Russian Embassy (off-route).

waypoints.name: Death Valley, California
waypoints.event: Walking through Death Valley.

waypoints.name: Las Vegas, Nevada
waypoints.event: In Las Vegas.

waypoints.name: Dacula, Georgia
waypoints.event: Photographed on Highway 124 near Dacula.

waypoints.name: Cameron, North Carolina (NC Hwy 24)
waypoints.event: On NC Hwy 24; son Adam with him for ~2 weeks.

waypoints.name: Richmond, Virginia area
waypoints.event: In the Richmond area; expected in Washington 'just after Labor Day'.

waypoints.name: Washington, D.C. – Russian Embassy
waypoints.event: End of protest walk; exact arrival date not found. New Russian visa / invitation 23 Oct 2014.

waypoints.name: Srednekolymsk, Yakutia (resumption)
waypoints.event: Restart at the 2011 stopping point, postponed to the weekend after 18 Mar 2015 (sled cargo delayed).

waypoints.name: Sasyr, Momsky district, Yakutia
waypoints.event: Karl's post: 'from Sasyr to the Road of Bones 2015'. Passage date unknown.

waypoints.name: Road of Bones (R504 Kolyma Highway) – junction point unknown
waypoints.event: Reached the Kolyma Highway in 2015. Where, and where the 2015 season ended, unknown.

waypoints.name: Yakutsk / Lena Highway (A360)
waypoints.event: Passage of Yakutsk not directly dated; afterwards followed the federal highway south and swam the Aldan (point unknown).

waypoints.name: Neryungri, Yakutia
waypoints.event: Met by rescue volunteer 8 Jun 2016; next stop Tynda via federal highway.

waypoints.name: Mogocha, Zabaykalsky Krai
waypoints.event: Geotagged Instagram photo from Mogocha (reported 5 Dec 2016); order relative to Erofey Pavlovich unclear.

waypoints.name: Erofey Pavlovich, Amur Oblast
waypoints.event: Geotagged photo 'in Erofey Pavlovich or approaching it'.

waypoints.name: Russia → Mongolia border crossing (point unknown)
waypoints.event: Crossed 'earlier this year' (HDM 8 Aug 2017); in Ulaanbaatar 8 Aug 2017 (Leg 04). End of Leg 03.

waypoints.name: Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia
waypoints.event: Arrives Ulaanbaatar; joins 'Steppes to the West' camel-caravan project (Baigalmaa Norjmaa). Camels trained at a camp west of the capital; caravan departs 'just before winter' 2017.

waypoints.name: Camel caravan dissolution point (location not sourced)
waypoints.event: Group fractures after ~1,000+ km (Karl: 'more than a thousand kilometres'; Explorersweb: 1,130 km). Angela Maxwell worked on the project 'From August to mid-December' 2017; by 25 Feb 2018 she wrote all members except Norjmaa had left. Exact place unknown.

waypoints.name: Mongolian desert, 'a couple of hundred kilometres from the Chinese border' (location not sourced)
waypoints.event: Karl walking alone with his cart ('The Beast') in Mongolian desert, battered by gales; father says he is a couple of hundred km from the Chinese border (date = report date).

waypoints.name: Mongolia–China border crossing (crossing point not sourced)
waypoints.event: Crosses into China alone, 2018.

waypoints.name: Xinjiang police stop / roadside tyre-repair shack (location not sourced; site only says security radiated 'out from Urumqi')
waypoints.event: Detained, gear searched, footage confiscated, told the walk was over; British Embassy intervened; allowed to continue on a mandated route with 24-h escort to the Kazakh border.

waypoints.name: China–Kazakhstan border crossing (crossing point not sourced)
waypoints.event: Enters (eastern) Kazakhstan. Year conflicts: 2018 (Explorersweb/Wikipedia) vs Karl's Aug 2024 remark '5 years after entering Eastern Kazakhstan' (implies ~2019).

waypoints.name: Almaty, Kazakhstan
waypoints.event: Meets partner 'Rika' in Almaty before pressing west. Departure from Almaty reported (onthegosolo) under July 2019 heading, but Uzbekistan entry reported as early June 2019 — see conflicts.

waypoints.name: Kazakhstan–Uzbekistan border crossing, 2019 (crossing point not sourced)
waypoints.event: Enters Uzbekistan ('early June 2019' per an unsourced Wikipedia edit quoted by onthegosolo).

waypoints.name: Samarkand, Uzbekistan
waypoints.event: Passes through Samarkand with Rika along the Silk Road.

waypoints.name: Bukhara, Uzbekistan (first passage, 2019)
waypoints.event: Passes Bukhara heading for Turkmenistan. Karl later calls Bukhara 'my last major waypoint in Uzbekistan before we entered Turkmenistan' — this becomes the 2023 continuity/restart point.

waypoints.name: Uzbekistan–Turkmenistan border (crossing point not sourced)
waypoints.event: Karl crosses alone (Rika could not, visa); 30-day Turkmen visa with government escort.

waypoints.name: Turkmenistan–Iran border (exact post not sourced) — furthest point of the abandoned Turkmen spur
waypoints.event: Reaches Iranian border as Turkmen visa expires; Iran visa refused. Dates conflict: father on 27 Aug 2019 'on the border'; El Informador '15 September'; Karl: 'By the end of 2019'.

waypoints.name: Ashgabat, Turkmenistan (flown out)
waypoints.event: Escorts hurry him to Ashgabat and put him on a plane; returns to Los Angeles, later Mexico. Equipment ('the Beast') left in an escort's garden in Turkmenistan.

waypoints.name: Bukhara, Uzbekistan (restart point, 2023)
waypoints.event: Walk resumes from Bukhara with Angela Maxwell ('Hitting the road 14/03/2023'). Backtrack abandons ~700 miles of Turkmen progress (Karl, 2021: 'losing almost 700 miles of progress').

waypoints.name: Nukus, Karakalpakstan, Uzbekistan
waypoints.event: 'first major waypoint Nukus' after 543 km from Bukhara (date = WBH post date). Leaves Uzbekistan for visa renewal (visits Baku).

waypoints.name: Uzbekistan–Kazakhstan border (crossing point not named in source)
waypoints.event: Crosses into Kazakhstan after 441 km from Nukus (water cached along a 260 km stretch 'past the Arial Sea'). Date = WBH post date for the crossing; Beyneu reached on the 28th, 87 km later.

waypoints.name: Beyneu, Mangystau, Kazakhstan
waypoints.event: Arrive Beyneu; rest/resupply; back on road 7 Jul 2023.

waypoints.name: Shetpe, Mangystau, Kazakhstan
waypoints.event: Arrive Shetpe after 309 km from Beyneu (date = WBH post date). Visa bounce needed; swim later postponed to Aug 2024.

waypoints.name: Caspian swim start point, Kazakh coast ('near Aktau' per press; exact point not published)
waypoints.event: Walk from Shetpe reaches start point ~28 Apr 2024 (~300 km, 14–28 Apr 2024). Swim begins mid-August 2024: planned start 16 Aug; on 16 Aug Karl posted the team was leaving 'south to the start point'; 31-day duration ending 17 Sep implies start ~17–18 Aug. Coordinates = Aktau town centre as proxy ONLY; true start is probably elsewhere on the coast (Shetpe→Aktau by road is well under 300 km — unresolved).

waypoints.name: Landfall, Azerbaijan — Sea Breeze resort (Nardaran area, Absheron, Baku)
waypoints.event: 'Task Complete: 18:30 – 17/9/2024'. Team arrives on the coast of Azerbaijan; welcomed 'In the resort city of Sea Breeze' by Deputy Minister Mariana Vasileva (other outlets say 'in Baku'). Coordinates approximate (Sea Breeze resort area), exact landing point not published.

waypoints.name: Baku, Azerbaijan (walk resumes westward)
waypoints.event: Leaves Baku heading west after the Caspian swim (Facebook photo post dated 9 Nov 2024 per On The Go Solo; official site reportedly says 10 Nov 2024). See conflicts.

waypoints.name: Batumi, Georgia
waypoints.event: Facebook video shows him in Batumi shortly before crossing into Turkey (reported second-hand by On The Go Solo). Route Baku→Batumi (incl. Az–Ge border crossing point, whether via Tbilisi) UNKNOWN.

waypoints.name: Sarp border gate (Georgia–Turkey), Kemalpaşa, Artvin
waypoints.event: Enters Turkey on foot through the Sarp Border Gate

waypoints.name: Hopa, Artvin, Turkey
waypoints.event: PLANNED first-day destination after Sarp (announced plan; actual date not confirmed)

waypoints.name: Samsun, Turkey
waypoints.event: Reaches Samsun after following the Black Sea coast; last coastal stop before turning inland toward Istanbul (NTV report 13 Mar 2025; Türkiye Gazetesi 17 Mar per On The Go Solo)

waypoints.name: Bolu, Turkey
waypoints.event: Instagram photo post from Bolu, ~160 miles (260 km) east of Istanbul (date = post date reported by On The Go Solo, not necessarily date at Bolu)

waypoints.name: Üsküdar, Istanbul (Asian side)
waypoints.event: Reaches Istanbul's Üsküdar district, end of Asian walking; awaits permission to cross Bosphorus. See conflicts for exact date.

waypoints.name: 15 July Martyrs (Bosphorus) Bridge, Istanbul – European end
waypoints.event: Walks across the 15 July Martyrs Bridge into Europe (special permission); leaves Turkey the same day because his 90-day stay was expiring. Coordinates = bridge midpoint (landmark); exact resume point on European side not reported.

waypoints.name: Kapıkule border gate, Edirne (Turkey–Bulgaria)
waypoints.event: Completes Turkey; exits via Kapıkule Border Gate into Bulgaria (Schengen). Istanbul→Edirne road UNKNOWN.

waypoints.name: Haskovo, Bulgaria
waypoints.event: On road 8 (via Haskovo, Plovdiv, Pazardzhik) toward Sofia

waypoints.name: Plovdiv, Bulgaria
waypoints.event: On road 8 toward Sofia

waypoints.name: Pazardzhik, Bulgaria
waypoints.event: On road 8 toward Sofia

waypoints.name: Sofia, Bulgaria
waypoints.event: In Sofia; Facebook reel invites followers to meet-up on Sat 20 Sep 2025; interviewed by Webcafe.bg (pub. 18 Sep 2025)

waypoints.name: Vidin, Bulgaria (Danube bridge to Romania) – PLANNED
waypoints.event: PLANNED: from Sofia over Stara Planina to Vidin, then cross the Danube bridge into Romania. Actual crossing point and date NOT confirmed.

waypoints.name: Romania (location unknown)
waypoints.event: Reported in Romania in October 2025, ~2,213 km from UK (Wikipedia citing archived westboundhorizons.com). Route through Romania UNKNOWN. Coordinates are a placeholder for the country only — do not plot as a route point.

waypoints.name: Budapest, Hungary
waypoints.event: Arrives in Budapest (TikTok post 15 Nov 2025); next target Vienna. Romania→Hungary border crossing UNKNOWN.

waypoints.name: Komárom, Hungary (or Komárno, Slovakia – ambiguous)
waypoints.event: Last public location record 'last Wednesday' before 5 Dec 2025 article = probably 3 Dec 2025 (inference). Article does not say which side of the Danube.

waypoints.name: Győr, Hungary (2025 stop point)
waypoints.event: Reached Győr before Christmas 2025, 'a few days' walk from the Austrian border'; then left Schengen for Mexico. Said he would resume 'close to the Hungary-Austria border' in March 2026 — exact stop point not reported.

waypoints.name: Hungary–Austria border (crossing point unknown)
waypoints.event: BBC 14 Mar 2026: 'days away from crossing into Austria from Hungary'. Exact crossing point/date UNKNOWN.

waypoints.name: Vienna, Austria
waypoints.event: Passes Vienna; hand-delivers the 1999 'world's slowest postcard' to Michael Bier's former neighbour (Guardian: 'which he eventually did — 27 years later'). Exact date unknown.

waypoints.name: Tulln an der Donau, Austria (Danube path)
waypoints.event: Facebook reel (posted 29 Mar, filmed 24 Mar) shows him on the Danube path north of Vienna, past Tulln

waypoints.name: Waldbüttelbrunn (near Würzburg), Germany
waypoints.event: Start of a 6-day, ~120 km stretch walked with Rosalind Perrett in May 2026 (began at 'Fuchsstadt' – which Fuchsstadt is ambiguous, not plotted). Austria→Würzburg route and Germany entry point UNKNOWN.

waypoints.name: Wertheim, Germany (Main valley)
waypoints.event: Waypoint on the May 2026 Fuchsstadt→Frankfurt stretch

waypoints.name: Miltenberg, Germany
waypoints.event: Waypoint on the May 2026 stretch (Collenberg also named, between Wertheim and Miltenberg)

waypoints.name: Obernburg am Main, Germany
waypoints.event: Waypoint on the May 2026 stretch

waypoints.name: Frankfurt Airport area, Germany
waypoints.event: End of the 6-day stretch; companions said goodbye 'outside Frankfurt Airport'. Frankfurt→Belgium route UNKNOWN.

waypoints.name: Belgium entry (point unknown)
waypoints.event: Finished Germany and entered Belgium 'in the past week' (On The Go Solo, 4 Jun 2026, from his Facebook videos). Crossing point UNKNOWN; placeholder coords only.

waypoints.name: Belgium – June 2026 stop point (unknown)
waypoints.event: Mid-June 2026: in Belgium when Eurotunnel refused service-tunnel access (BBC 16 Jun 2026); then left Schengen (Wikipedia: to Mexico). Exact stop point UNKNOWN.

waypoints.name: Havré (Mons), Belgium
waypoints.event: BBC reporter joins him for a 5-mile stretch Havré → Mons on the 'final march to Calais' (article pub. 19 Sep 2026; walk date not stated)

waypoints.name: Mons (Grand-Place), Belgium
waypoints.event: Arrives Mons Grand-Place

waypoints.name: Tournai, Belgium
waypoints.event: Stopover in Tournai (unplanned, administrative reasons/medical certificate); met Louis-Philippe Loncke on Fri 18 Sep 2026

waypoints.name: France entry (point unknown)
waypoints.event: Enters France (Wikipedia: 20 Sep 2026; its cited NoTélé source does not actually state this). Route Tournai→coast UNKNOWN.

waypoints.name: Channel swim departure point, French coast (UNDISCLOSED)
waypoints.event: Start of multi-day Channel swim. Team deliberately kept departure location and time private. Loncke (19 Sep) said he would 'reach Calais next week' and swim 'from Calais to Dover'; BBC (Jun) said he expected to reach Calais. Coordinates are a generic Calais-area placeholder, NOT a reported start point.

waypoints.name: Shakespeare Beach, Dover, England
waypoints.event: Landfall 15:30 BST Monday 5 Oct 2026 after ~20 h swimming over three days; met by father Keith, brothers, friends, Werner Herzog. Coordinates = beach location (landmark), precise landing spot not reported.

waypoints.name: Dover, England (walk north begins)
waypoints.event: Rested in Dover, then started walking to Hull (Guardian implies 8 Oct; Fox says 9 Oct). Angela Maxwell walking with him from Dover.

waypoints.name: Market Rasen, Lincolnshire, England
waypoints.event: AP photographs him on a road near Market Rasen, 'about 30 miles from the finish line'. Route Dover→Lincolnshire (Thames crossing, London?, Cambridgeshire?) UNKNOWN.

waypoints.name: Humber Bridge (Barton-upon-Humber → Hessle)
waypoints.event: Crossed the Humber Bridge 'through thick mist' on Sun 1 Nov 2026, with crowds lining the bridge (BBC, updated 1 Nov 18:04 UTC). Time of day not reported. BBC (same article) says he would set off on Mon 2 Nov from Hessle, at the north end of the bridge; where he spent the night of 1 Nov is not reported.

waypoints.name: Queen Victoria Square / City Hall, Hull – civic welcome
waypoints.event: Mon 2 Nov 2026: 'hundreds of people cheered his arrival at City Hall' (AP); ESPN: 'his final stop at Queen Victoria Square in the city centre before returning to his mother's house'. 'Sorry to keep you waiting,' he joked. The council's plan (S32) gave ~11:00 and a stage welcome by Lord Mayor Cllr Maria Coward; no post-event report gives the actual time or confirms the Lord Mayor's part. Not the official finish point.

waypoints.name: Mother's home, Sutton Park estate, Hull – official finish
waypoints.event: Mon 2 Nov 2026: walked on from City Hall and was reunited with his mother Angela outside her terraced house in Hull (AP; Reuters via Al Jazeera), ending the Goliath Expedition. Time of arrival not reported. Arrival reports say only 'his mother's home' / 'north Hull'; the Sutton Park estate comes from earlier BBC reporting (S34, S35). Exact address not public (and should not be plotted precisely).

On New Year's Day 2003, a day away from crossing into Canada, Bushby's handcart was stolen while he was visiting a bar in Toole County, Montana. ... Between 17 and 31 March 2006, Bushby and French adventurer Dimitri Kieffer successfully crossed the Bering Strait on foot, having to take a roundabout 14-day route across a frozen 150-mile section to cross the 58-mile wide strait ... detained by Russian border troop officers while they were crossing the Russian border near the Chukotkan village of Uelen ... Karl left it behind and crossed into China alone. | In 2018, Karl crossed into China ... The police let him keep walking — under a strictly mandated route, a twenty-four-hour escort, no camping, and later no internet access — all the way to the Kazakh border. | Across the Kazakh border, Karl met up with Rika in Almaty before pressing west. ... Karl and Rika followed the Silk Road through Samarkand and the old trading hub of Bukhara, heading toward Turkmenistan. ...
